review_mode: independent valuation-auditor recalculation followed by house-model repair

findings.evidence: The initial model added convertible shares without resolving effective-interest treatment and omitted approved treasury-share reissuance.
findings.fix_required: Use a three-level share bridge, include disclosed employee-plan dilution and cash, and avoid unsupported interest add-back.

findings.evidence: The external target used 3.603bn forecast shares and was not comparable with the house diluted denominator.
findings.fix_required: Convert the external target to total equity value, add disclosed plan cash, and divide by the house disclosed-dilution shares.

findings.evidence: The original house base duplicated the same CNY7.91bn external forecast used in the Street anchor.
findings.fix_required: Construct an independent CNY7.75bn house base from H1 midpoint plus CNY2.0bn H2 normalization and retain the broker forecast only as an external comparison.

findings.evidence: A technical support level had been presented as the fair-value lower bound and the market anchor lacked a formula.
findings.fix_required: Derive the core range from the house base and multiples, keep technical support separate, and define the market anchor from five-session VWAP and current price.
